title: fix(build): validate inline capabilities from the config file
body: Capabilities declared inline under `app > security > capabilities` skipped tauri-build's validation, so a typo in a permission identifier only surfaced as the generic `failed to resolve ACL` codegen panic. Validate the same capability set codegen resolves so the friendly "Permission X not found" error is reported instead.
